name: callback-commitment
description: The decision maker is unavailable and promises a callback. The call must end as a structured callback commitment, not a quote and not a decline.

transcript.message: Hi, this is WrenchBid, an AI assistant phoning on behalf of a customer. I need an itemized quote for a confirmed scope: 2020 Toyota Camry SE, 62,000 miles, replace front brake pads and rotors with premium aftermarket parts, Charlotte, North Carolina 28202, completion within 7 days.
Our service manager handles quotes and he's out until tomorrow. He'll call you back in the morning with exact numbers.
Thank you — I'm noting a callback commitment for tomorrow morning. Which number will the manager call from?
This one, the shop's main line.
Great. I'll record the callback commitment for tomorrow morning. Thank you for your time.
